main_text.p: Sníamo, Velociter, Confestim: & alibi stamo] Vide Stsotunoon.
Solre,solium : an solartam?] Quod nobis a sollar.
Sotwilcan, & sotwels, Quacunq;] Hoc Sax. ͬpa ḥpilc.
Stotingon, Increpatione. Nos pro stimulatione] Stimulatio nobis stng. Quidam etiam nostratium dicunt ts stonnes, pro stimulat.
Staf-swert, Framea] Et gladius, & framea, Saxon. ꝩpeopo, quod nobis stwoɿD. Hoc autem Verstegano nostro stasstweard.
Stedinust, stabilitatem] Nobis eodem sensu, stedDinesse.
Stros,strati : vide Stoje] Sternere Sax. stṗepian; stratum, stṗepeᴅ, & stṗæᴅ; unde iis stṗæᴛ, nobis street, pro via, platea.
Soligon, salsuginem] Sal Saxon. ꝩealᴛ, nobis salf.
Saitho; Nimis] Hoc Sax. ꝩpẏḥe s

page.notes: Marginal annotations in pencil at upper right (Ꝺ, 2 4) are not printed text and are omitted. Black letter headwords are rendered approximately; the Saxon and Greek-type glosses are uncertain and may contain errors.
